titulo: Dillard's, Jan 2021: stock buybacks about 16 times the retention credit. Do the math.
caption:
Dillard's, Jan 2021: stock buybacks about 16 times the retention credit. Do the math.

Dillard's. Stock buybacks, fiscal 2020: $102.8 million. Payroll expense and related benefits reduced by the employee retention credit under the CARES Act: $6.1 million.

From the archive: Jan 2021. Not today's news.

The math: $102,879,000 (treasury stock purchased, fiscal 2020) ÷ $6,100,000 (payroll expense reduced by the employee retention credit, fiscal 2020) = about 16 times the retention credit. We round down.
Both numbers come from one 10-K, for the same fiscal year. The 10-K calls it the employee retention credit available under the CARES Act. Both numbers are Dillard's own, for fiscal 2020, which ended January 30, 2021. The company rounds the credit.

(Our take.) Two lines, one 10-K. Read them side by side.

Sources
F1: Dillard's Form 10-K for fiscal 2020, filed Mar 29, 2021 · https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/28917/000002891721000066/dds-20210130.htm

The quotes on screen are copied from the filings. Original music. No narration.
